source: the turn answering 'try it on an excerpt of Aristotle'

nodes.text: the Barbara syllogism from Prior Analytics, filed with scheme deduction and strength robust, passed with no finding
De Caelo's eclipse argument, filed with scheme sign and strength robust, was convicted by a-conclusion-is-no-stronger-than-its-warrant, although its conclusion that the earth is spherical is true
the Politics natural-slavery argument, filed with scheme example and strength robust, was convicted by the same law
the checker discriminates by the warrant a conclusion rests on, not by whether the conclusion is true
